description: Election Commission - Declare that K. T. G. Ruwani Nisansala as a Member of the Wanathawilluwa Pradeshiya Sabhe
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Wanathawilluwa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, as governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new elected member to fill a vacant seat, which falls under the Elections category.
